253:> If **Run all** is disabled, no models are selected or a run for that suite is already in progress. For non-environment suites, a missing connected server also disables it. When every model the suite would run is out of MCPJam credits, **Run all** and each case's **Run** button are disabled with an "Out of MCPJam credits · resets in …" tooltip, switching any case to a model from your own providers re-enables those buttons. The header pickers will tell you which condition applies.
448:* **Run insights**: an AI-written diff against your previous completed run: which cases moved, which tools changed behavior, which models diverged. Skim this first; it usually points at the right rabbit hole. The model pass is **included with MCPJam and consumes no credits**; it counts against a daily insight quota shared with swarm wave and user-testing insights. Guests browsing without a signed-in account will see a **Sign in** prompt in the insights band. Signing in unlocks the feature without losing your place.
486:When two or more host configurations are attached to a suite, a **By case / By host** toggle appears. **By host** shows a matrix: one column per host, one row per case. Each cell shows pass/fail dots, pass rate, median latency, and token usage. A host detached after runs were recorded stays visible, labelled **historical**.
488:### Cost

495:A dash (`—`) means **no cost was observed**, never that the trial was free:
499:| Your own API key (BYOK) | MCPJam did not bill it, so there is no cost to report. |
500:| No token usage reported | Nothing to price. |

532:* **Per-iteration row** with case, model, pass/fail, tokens, cost, duration, and the tool calls that actually happened. Each row also shows a one-line summary of where that trial's user-value chain stopped (for example `broke at Tool response`, `Request satisfied`, or `chain withheld`) so you can scan the table without opening each row.
546:Select any two completed runs and click **Compare**. The diff view shows per-case status changes: **Passed**, **Still failing**, **Regressed** (pass→fail), **Fixed** (fail→pass), **New**, **Removed**, and **Changed** (config differed). Summary metrics show deltas for tokens, cost, and duration. In the per-run comparison table, metric deltas (pass rate, P50, P95, tokens) appear inline beside their value rather than in separate Δ columns. Pass-rate movement is shown as a percentage delta (for example, `+10%`).
